amendments.note: Amendment 1 (post hoc, recorded after reading the 4.096M results and before any result of the extension existed): the registered B1 (64 paired-seat episodes per seed, W 1000) is limited by measurement noise (per-seed stderr 0.23, about the between-seed SD 0.26). A powered B1 is added: 256 further paired-seat episodes per seed on a new root (H2H_ROOT + 10 = 89,310), W 1000, separate vs shared, for the 4.096M and the 8.192M finals, reported with its pooled per-seed estimate (64 + 256 episodes weighted by count). The registered 64-episode B1 remains the statistic of the pre-registered classification.

Amendment 2 (exploratory, post hoc, recorded before any result of the extension existed): a natural-play economy profile, motivated by the separate critic's changed response to unspent gold (+4 unspent gold: shared -0.10, separate +0.01 at neutral L8). Each 4.096M and 8.192M final and each start playing itself from s0, 16 games x 600 turns on seeds shared within a seed (NATCF_ROOT + 50 + s): the M4.5c game summary, unspent gold at Recall and while present, invested gold at turns 150 / 300 / 600. Descriptive only; it does not enter the classification.
